results.redactedSql:
WITH project_sales AS (
  SELECT
    SUM(ps.service_quantity) AS service_count,
    SUM(ps.net_amount) AS project_revenue
  FROM agent_v3_project_service_sales_view AS ps
  WHERE ps.store_id = ANY(:allowedStoreIds)
    AND ps.order_created_at >= :startAt::date
    AND ps.order_created_at < :endAt::date
)
SELECT
  MAX(project_sales.service_count) AS service_count,
  MAX(project_sales.project_revenue) AS project_revenue,
  SUM(oi.quantity) AS sales_quantity,
  SUM(oi.net_amount) AS net_sales_amount
FROM agent_v3_order_item_sales_view AS oi
CROSS JOIN project_sales
WHERE oi.store_id = ANY(:allowedStoreIds)
  AND oi.order_created_at >= :startAt::date
  AND oi.order_created_at < :endAt::date
LIMIT 1;
